title: Two filtered searches pick the 5 sources before the one model call
subtitle: Example: a made-up question about PAY-4012, with the real rules of the query path.

steps.label:
prompt: rules, [1] runbook ·
[2] ticket OPS-8812 … [5], question

outcome.title: The operator gets an answer with two linked sources
lines: The model saw only the 5 chunks the caller may read, and each [n] opens its source to check before acting.

captions.title: Carry the caller's access groups with the question
captions.text: Your normal login says who asks and which groups they belong to. The model will quote anything retrieved, so the groups travel with the question, and every search filters by them.

captions.title: Turn the question into an embedding
captions.text: A separate, cheap model, voyage-3, turns the question into 1,024 numbers. It must be the same model as the chunks, or the results look random. The question goes as `input_type "query"`, the chunks as `"document"`.

captions.title: Run two searches, each filtered inside the SQL
captions.text: Vector search finds the question by meaning but may miss the code PAY-4012. Keyword search finds PAY-4012 but misses paraphrases. Both run with `access_groups && :callerGroups` in the `WHERE` and `LIMIT 50`.

captions.title: Merge the two lists by rank and keep 5
captions.text: The two scores are on unrelated scales, so RRF uses positions only: rank r scores 1/(60 + r). The runbook, keyword #1 and vector #3 (example ranks), scores 0.0323 and beats a page that is vector #1 alone (0.0164).

captions.title: Number the sources in the prompt
captions.text: The prompt holds the rules, then sources [1] to [5] in rank order, then the question. It says to cite as [1], [2], and to say "I don't know" when the sources do not hold the answer.

captions.title: Call the model and check its citations
captions.text: One user message with `max_tokens` 1024. A stop reason of `max_tokens` instead of `end_turn` means the answer was cut off. Your code turns each [n] into the link of source n, and an answer with no citation gets a warning.
